summary: AstraZeneca PLC furnished a Form 6-K containing its standard UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1 total voting rights notification as of 31 October 2026. Issued share capital with voting rights is 1,551,065,237 ordinary shares of US$0.25, with no shares held in treasury, so total voting rights equal that figure. The notice supplies the denominator shareholders use to calculate disclosure obligations under the FCA rules. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is involved; this is a routine periodic transparency filing with no deal or risk-arb angle.
